paper.title: Adversarial Attacks on Linear Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Online adversarial attacks on contexts of a linear contextual bandit (LinUCB, white-box)
unmapped: The guarantee is for an attacker (not the learner): the attacker perturbs contexts shown to LinUCB to force pulls of target arms A^dagger with small cumulative perturbation cost
Disjoint per-arm linear model: reward <theta_a, x_t> + noise with K arm parameters
Attacker knows a lower bound nu on the target-arm reward (Assumption 2) and has white-box access to LinUCB
Expected rewards in (0,1] for all contexts and arms
settings.definition_quote: At each time $t$, the agent observes a context $x_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$, selects an action $a_{t}\in \llbracket 1, K\rrbracket$ and observes a reward: $r_{t,a_{t}} = \langle \theta_{a_{t}}, x_{t}\rangle + \eta_{a_{t}}^{t}$ ... We denote by $\widetilde{x}_t$ the context after the attack and by $c_t = \|x_t - \widetilde{x}_t\|_2$ the instantaneous cost.

symbols.nu: known lower bound on target-arm expected reward (Assumption 2)

conditions: Assumption 2: for every context some target arm has reward >= nu > 0

source.label: prop:cost_attack_all_ctx
source.quote: Using the attack described in Fig.~\ref{alg:context_attack_protocol} and assuming that $\|x\|_{2}\leq \nu L/2$ for all contexts $x\in\mathcal{D}$, for any $\delta\in (0,1/K]$, with probability at least $1 - K\delta$, the number of times \linucb does not pull an arm in $A^{\dagger}$ before time $T$ is at most $\sum_{j\notin A^{\dagger}} N_{j}(T) \leq 32K^{2}\left( \frac{\lambda}{\alpha^{2}} + \sigma^{2}d\log\left(\frac{\lambda d + TL^2\alpha^{2}}{d\lambda\delta}\right) \right)^{3}$

results.notes: Bound on number of non-target pulls by attacked LinUCB, holding w.p. >= 1-K delta. Not a regret bound; quantity 'other'.

symbols.nu: known lower bound on target-arm expected reward (Assumption 2)

conditions: Assumption 2: for every context some target arm has reward >= nu > 0

source.label: prop:cost_attack_all_ctx
source.quote: The total cost for the attacker is bounded by: $   \sum_{t=1}^{T} c_{t} \leq \frac{64K^{2}}{\nu}\left( \frac{\lambda}{\alpha^{2}} + \sigma^{2}d\log\left(\frac{\lambda d + TL^2\alpha^{2}}{d\lambda\delta}\right) \right)^{3}$ with $\alpha = 2/\nu$.

results.notes: Cumulative attack cost (sum of context perturbation norms), w.p. >= 1-K delta. Propositions 1, 3, 4 (o(T) statements / qualitative) not recorded since no explicit expression.

cited_results.setting_description: Adversarial bandits with expert advice, K arms, N experts
